title: Design-Build for Storm Eye 4th Floor Renovation
short_description: Design-build renovation of an ophthalmology clinic floor at MUSC in Charleston.
project_scope: Renovation of approximately 8,000 square feet on the 4th floor of the Storm Eye ophthalmology clinic to provide a total of 18 exam lanes. The renovation is planned in approximately four phases while the clinic remains operational during construction.
services: Design-build services for renovation/refurbishment, including construction/project management.
relevance_explanation:
- Small interior renovation of an existing clinic floor with limited structural ambition.
- Primarily a healthcare fit-out/refurbishment project, not a bridge, long-span roof, special structure, or complex building structure.
- Tender focuses on design-build and construction/project management rather than specialized structural engineering.
- Keeping the clinic operational adds phasing complexity, but this is not a strong match for sbp's core profile.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the source. Available scope information for estimation: approximately 8,000 SF healthcare clinic renovation, phased in 4 stages, occupied renovation, 18 exam lanes. A realistic cost estimate is possible only very roughly; depending on medical fit-out level, such work could vary widely.
fee_explanation: No fee information is provided in the source. Since the procurement is design-build, a separate structural engineering fee for sbp cannot be derived reliably from the available information.
references_qualifications: Disciplines requested: Design Build/Developer, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Construction/Project Management. No specific reference counts or qualification thresholds are stated in the source excerpt.
